context.summary: The strict-quorum regression currently hard-codes the 8-of-11 threshold even though the tested analyzer defines the threshold mathematically.

objective: Remove the hard-coded `need = 8` threshold from the strict-quorum E015 regression and derive the required vote count from the same floor(q*n)+1 rule used by the analyzer, without weakening the existing defect/fix assertions.

outputs.description: Unverified candidate patch against the frozen source revision.
